1970.notes: Rate on income from professions, employments, trade or business (pre-1971 class 3 income, the predecessor of Part B earned income): 4% under Ch. 796 of the Acts of 1967 (effective 1968), per the rate and surtax chronology (Appendix A) of the 1986 House No. 6443 report; no surtax was in force 1967-1974 (Ch. 698 of 1966 repealed all surtaxes, the next was Ch. 684 of 1975). Interest, dividends and capital gains 8% and annuities 2% taxed differently. No standard deduction; personal exemptions under Ch. 698 of 1966 (amounts not verified), so no deduction recorded. Federal income tax deduction abolished by Ch. 546 of 1969.

1971.notes: Part B rate 5% under Ch. 555 of 1971 (Commission report chronology; surtax history before 1975 not fully legible in the scanned report). Part B (wages and other earned income) rate; Part A investment income taxed differently. No standard deduction. Personal exemption $2,000 single (raised to $2,200 in 1982); the joint exemption depended on the lower-earning spouse's earned income, so no deduction recorded.
